title: GitHub Provider Auth State v1
description: Canonical GitHub provider authentication state. Records token metadata and presence, never token material. Explicitly forbids raw token values through additionalProperties: false and constrained field vocabulary.

account_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the GitHub account identifier. Never the raw username or account ID.

installation_id_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the GitHub App installation ID. Empty string if not using GitHub App auth.

scopes_or_permissions.description: Requested and granted scopes or permissions.

token_storage_authority.description: Where token material is stored. Must not be forbidden_json_file.

token_material_present.description: True if a token is currently available to the provider runtime.

token_material_stored.description: Must always be false. The auth state artifact must never contain raw token material.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the current token expires. Empty string if no token.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this auth state record was generated.

redaction_status.description: Redaction status of this auth state record.
